intent: Single-variable step from the iteration 7 design: reduce wheel_track from 0.11 to 0.105 m to add turn authority on alternating bends, where slalom off_track endings (5/20) are the remaining limit. All other geometry is unchanged so the Integrator's controller carries over and the effect of the track change can be read directly. Expect slalom finishes to rise from 15/20 toward 17/20 with oval and s-bend completions held.
learning: Iteration 7 showed the agility gains are flattening: slalom finishes went from 14/20 to 15/20 and the score rose only 5 points. Next, check (a) whether slalom finishes rise to 16 or more with wheel_track 0.105 m; (b) whether slalom steering_oscillation stays under about 0.32, which would show damping is still adequate; (c) whether oval and s-bend completion rates hold at 20/20 and 18/20 or better; (d) whether the slalom off_track cases now have max_error below 0.06. Ask the Integrator whether kd needs retuning after the track change.
rationale: Iteration 7 is the best design so far (score 889.3). Oval and s-bend both finish 20/20, and slalom finishes 15/20 with mean progress 0.95. The gain over iteration 6 was small (+5 points), so the agility lever is flattening. The remaining slalom failures are off_track endings (5/20), with max_error near 0.034 and line_loss_events about 1.25. That points to turn response on alternating bends rather than sensing or speed, since the slalom finish time of about 2.24 s leaves speed margin. The off-track floor is 0.06 m at body_width 0.08 m, and body_length (0.10 m) and mass (0.40 m minimum) are already at their limits, so wheel_track is the only remaining yaw-authority lever. The step from 0.115 to 0.11 m (iteration 6 to 7) raised slalom finishes by one, so I will take one more small step: wheel_track 0.11 to 0.105 m. Everything else is held fixed so the effect is attributable: sensors (7 at x = ±0.03 m, y = 0.08 m, 12 mm footprint), wheel_radius 0.04 m, body 0.10 x 0.08 m, mass 0.40 kg. Expected result: slalom finishes rise from 15/20 toward 17/20, and oval and s-bend completions hold at 20/20 and 18/20 or better. Risk: steering_oscillation (0.30 on the slalom now) rises past about 0.32 with less damping, which would call for more kd from the Integrator. If that happens, I will hold the track at 0.11 m and look at sensing instead.
